read_scope: Relevant bounded source ranges and API declarations only; scheduler/tool full files were not exhaustively read. Hashes authenticate full files. No native runtime invocation.

contracts.claim: Conversation.abort enables scheduling globally before the conversation-scoped mark commit.
One scheduler reservation pass can reserve all eligible tasks across conversations; replay-safe tool execute checkpoints may call execute again.
Harness.open awaits running-to-pending normalization with the exact saved checkpoint before returning; scheduler initially disabled.
Public Harness.inspect is read-only, reports scheduling and live TaskInspection.record plus unsettled submissions.

Public abortTask delegates to scheduler.abort, which commits abort intent without enabling scheduling; marking exact recovered roots and tools while paused prevents this specific serial-abort reentry gap.

limitations: Source contract and pure public-API test doubles only; actual native HTTP workload is not executed or frozen.
Paused assertions are boundary observations under one process owner, not a fence against a concurrent resumer.
Exact original chain identities and current inspect shape must be validated before marking; arbitrary same-conversation work must never be marked.
Numeric native conversation IDs repeat across independent Sessions; remote effect identity/authority must include a stable scope per Session. Root owns that prefreeze transport change.
